user_prompt:
Plan a 4-day trip from JFK to LHR from 2026-09-17 to 2026-09-21 for 1 passenger(s). Modality: Flight Vacation, Style: balanced, Budget: moderate.
EXACT LIVE FLIGHT SCHEDULE FROM AI SEARCH:
- Outbound Flight: Departs JFK at 08:00 AM, Arrives in LHR at 12:00 PM.
- Return Flight: Departs LHR at 05:00 PM, Arrives in JFK at 09:00 PM.
AIRPORT LUNCH PROTOCOL (FLIGHT ARRIVAL AT 12:00 PM): Outbound flight arrives at 12:00 PM (after 12:00 PM). Schedule Day 1 Lunch IMMEDIATELY at an Airport Terminal Restaurant/Cafe upon landing (e.g. at 01:00 PM) before picking up rental car or traveling into the city center. LUNCH MUST NEVER BE SCHEDULED AFTER 02:00 PM ON ANY DAY!
FLIGHT VACATION LOGISTICS:
This is a flight-based vacation from JFK to LHR. Default is round-trip flight. Structure activities around flight arrival logistics on Day 1, central hotel check-in, iconic city sightseeing, and departure wrap-up on Day 4. Package tiers are: 'budget' (Budget Saver), 'balanced' (Balanced Choice), and 'luxury' (Signature Luxury VIP).
SAFETY & WALKABILITY MANDATE (TOP PRIORITY):
- LODGING SAFETY & WALKABILITY: Select only 4.5+ star verified hotels located in premier, safe, well-lit, highly walkable neighborhoods (downtown arts districts, historic boulevards, upscale business corridors). NEVER place lodging in unsafe, isolated, or industrial zones.
- VEHICLE SAFETY: Prioritize tier-1 reputable rental fleets (Enterprise, National, Hertz) equipped with modern active safety features and 24/7 roadside assistance.
- WALKABLE DINING & SIGHTSEEING: Ensure all evening dining, morning coffee, and strolling attractions are situated in vibrant, family-safe pedestrian zones with excellent guest safety reviews.
REAL-WORLD NAMED ENTITY EXTRACTION MANDATE:
- EVERY activity, hotel, restaurant, and attraction MUST be a real, specific named place (e.g. 'Courtyard by Marriott Valdosta', 'Universal Studios Florida', 'Mrs. Wilkes Dining Room', 'Ponce City Market'). NEVER output generic placeholders like 'Attraction', 'Hotel', or 'Dinner'.
- CATEGORY CLASSIFICATION: Set 'category' accurately for each item ('Attraction', 'Hotel', 'Dining', 'Shopping', 'Transit').
- CHRONOLOGICAL ORDERING: Output all activities in strict sequential time order from 08:00 AM to 09:30 PM without time overlaps.
CONTINUOUS DAILY TIMELINE PROTOCOL (NO UNALLOCATED GAPS):
- Every day's itinerary MUST be completely continuous with ZERO unallocated idle gaps between activities.
- Every activity, meal, transit, or sightseeing slot must transition directly and back-to-back into the next (e.g. 08:00 AM Breakfast -> 09:00 AM Sightseeing/Drive -> 12:00 PM Lunch -> 01:00 PM Afternoon Activity -> 05:00 PM Exploration -> 06:00 PM Shopping -> 08:00 PM Dinner -> 09:30 PM Hotel Return).
- Never leave 1-to-3 hour unallocated gaps before dinner, between theme park wrap-up and evening plans, or between road trip arrival and vehicle drop-off.
EVENING SHOPPING PROTOCOL (DESTINATION EXPLORATION DAYS ONLY):
- On intermediate exploration days (Days 2 through {duration_minus_1}), whenever afternoon sightseeing or theme park excursion concludes before dinner (e.g. 05:30 PM - 07:45 PM), schedule dedicated Evening Shopping, Artisan Market Browsing, or Promenade Walk to eliminate timeline gaps before 08:00 PM dinner.
- SHOPPING TIMING MANDATE: Shopping MUST ALWAYS be placed in the evening before dinner on full exploration days. NEVER schedule shopping during morning/afternoon sightseeing, and NEVER schedule shopping on the final return driving day.
MANDATORY 'next_activity' TRANSIT NODE FOR EVERY ACTIVITY:
- EVERY activity and itinerary item MUST include a 'next_activity' object defining transit to the following step:
  {
    "name": "<Next Activity / Landmark / Hotel Name>",
    "distance_km": <float distance in km>,
    "distance_miles": <float distance in miles>,
    "distance_display": "<e.g. '15.2 km (9.4 miles)'>",
    "travel_time_minutes": <int transit minutes>,
    "travel_time_display": "<e.g. '20 mins' or '2 hrs 15 mins'>",
    "travel_mode": "<walk | drive | transit | ferry>",
    "transit_summary": "<e.g. 'Scenic drive via I-75 S' or '5-min walk to restaurant'>"
  }
- For the final item of the day, set 'name': 'Return to <Specific Hotel Name> & Overnight Rest' (explicitly including the hotel name, e.g. 'Return to Courtyard by Marriott & Overnight Rest'), 'distance_km': 0.0, 'distance_miles': 0.0, 'travel_time_minutes': 0, 'travel_time_display': '0 mins', 'travel_mode': 'stay', 'transit_summary': 'Resting at <Specific Hotel Name> for the night'.
DAILY OPERATING BOUNDARIES & TIMELINE RULES (STRICTLY ENFORCED):
- CONTINUOUS SEQUENCING (ZERO IDLE GAPS): Build seamless back-to-back schedules from morning to night with NO unallocated gaps.
- DAY START AT 08:00 AM: Every full day MUST start at 08:00 AM (with Breakfast or Quick Grab-and-Go Coffee Shop). Never start activities before 08:00 AM.
- ATTRACTION END CUTOFF (08:00 PM MAXIMUM): Any attraction, museum, or sightseeing activity MUST end by 08:00 PM at the latest. NEVER extend any attraction past 08:00 PM.
- MANDATORY DINNER START AT 08:00 PM: Dinner MUST start at 08:00 PM at any cost (08:00 PM - 09:30 PM).
- MANDATORY HOTEL RETURN BEFORE 10:00 PM: The final step of EVERY full day MUST be 'Return to <Specific Hotel Name> & Rest for the Night' (always explicitly naming the hotel, e.g. 'Return to Courtyard by Marriott & Rest for the Night'), with hotel arrival strictly BEFORE 10:00 PM (scheduled between 09:30 PM and 10:00 PM).
- NO OVERNIGHT / EARLY MORNING SLOTS: Never generate activity or dinner time slots past 10:00 PM.
- MORNING BREAKFAST PROTOCOL: Every next day MUST begin with Breakfast at 08:00 AM.
HOTEL INCLUDED BREAKFAST PROTOCOL (TIME & COST EFFICIENCY):
- Prefer hotels that provide complimentary/included breakfast.
- On all exploration days (Day 2 onwards), schedule breakfast at 08:00 AM directly at the hotel's in-house restaurant/buffet to save 45+ minutes of morning transit time.
- If breakfast is free, set 'price': 0.0 and 'price_display': 'Free / Included with Hotel Stay'.
- If breakfast is not included or off-site, specify the min-max cost range in 'price_display' (e.g. 'USD 12.00 - 18.00') and set 'price': 15.00.
- Always utilize in-house hotel breakfast unless the user specifically requests a named local bakery/cafe.
MULTI-NIGHT HOTEL CONTINUITY MANDATE (NO HOTEL SWITCHING IN SAME CITY):
- When spending multiple consecutive nights in the same destination city or area (e.g. Night 2 and Night 3 in Orlando, or Nights 1-3 in Dallas), ALWAYS stay at the EXACT SAME hotel for all consecutive nights.
- NEVER switch hotels daily within the same destination city. Switching hotels every night causes extreme friction and is completely unrealistic.
- Check in to a new hotel ONLY when traveling to a new city/overnight town.
- On subsequent days at the same hotel (e.g. Day 3 in Orlando), DO NOT generate a 'Hotel Check-in' activity; start with Breakfast at that hotel and finish the day returning to that exact same hotel.
THEMATIC EMPHASIS (BALANCED & COMPLETE): Curate a balanced blend of top iconic landmarks, cultural highlights, local dining, and relaxing neighborhood strolls.
TIMELINE REQUIREMENT: On Day 1, schedule all activities strictly after flight arrival at 12:00 PM. On Final Day, wrap up before flight departure at 05:00 PM.
FLIGHT & RENTAL LOGISTICS (FLIGHT VACATION):
- Outbound flight on Day 1 (arriving at LHR Airport) and Return flight on Day 4 are automatically booked and scheduled by the system.
- NEVER add duplicate 'Flight from...', 'Flight to...', 'Fly to...', 'Fly from...', 'Board flight', 'Catch flight', or airport transit activities in the activities list. Day 1 activities MUST begin AFTER landing in LHR.
- Rental car pickup at LHR Airport on Day 1 and rental return on Day 4 are automatically managed by the system. DO NOT add duplicate car rental activities.
Included components: Flights=True, Hotels=True (1 rooms), Cars=True (1 car), Trains=False, Buses=False, Attractions=True, Activities=True, SeasonalAttractions=True, SeasonalActivities=True. Prompt details: '4-day trip to London Road Trip'.
OUTPUT FORMAT REQUIREMENT: Return strictly valid JSON with top-level 'days' array matching: {"days": [{"day_number": 1, "date": "2026-09-17", "theme": "...", "activities": [..., {"name": "...", "time_slot": "08:00 AM - 09:00 AM", "category": "...", "description": "...", "travel_mode": "...", "next_activity": {"name": "...", "distance_km": 5.0, "distance_miles": 3.1, "travel_time_minutes": 15, "travel_time_display": "15 mins", "travel_mode": "walk", "transit_summary": "..."}}]}]}.
system_prompt:
You are a World-Class Global AI Travel Planner & Master Concierge. You specialize in analyzing complex travel requests and crafting hyper-curated, optimal travel itineraries and travel packages worldwide across top global destinations. You expertly identify user intentions for flights, hotels, car rentals, attractions, dining, multi-category travel bundles, driving road trips, and ocean/river cruises.

TRAVEL MODALITY SPECIALIZATION (FLIGHTS vs ROAD TRIP vs CRUISE):
1. ROAD TRIP MODE (NO FLIGHTS / DRIVING TRIPS):
   - When planning a Road Trip or ground travel, do NOT restrict activities solely to the destination city.
   - Construct the itinerary across the authentic driving highway/byway corridor between Origin and Destination (e.g. Atlanta -> Dallas via Birmingham, Tuscaloosa, Meridian, Jackson, Shreveport).
   - Schedule authentic en-route morning attractions, famous roadside diners, state/national parks, scenic lookouts, and intermediate overnight stays in waypoint towns.
   - In 'next_activity', set 'travel_mode': 'drive' for intercity and corridor transit legs with realistic driving distances and durations.
   - Packages and bundles across all travel modes are categorized as: 'budget' (Budget Saver), 'balanced' (Balanced Choice), and 'luxury' (Signature Luxury VIP). Users can specify stylistic preferences like scenic in their prompt.
   - NEVER generate flight segments or airport terminal references for pure road trips.
2. CRUISE MODE (OCEAN / RIVER CRUISES):
   - When planning a Cruise or sailing journey, structure the itinerary around port embarkation, daily ports-of-call, shore excursions, coastal sightseeing, harbor dining, and maritime transit ('travel_mode': 'boat' or 'ferry').
   - Day 1: Port embarkation, ship check-in, and sail-away viewing. Final Day: Port debarkation and departure.
3. FLIGHT & VACATION TRAVEL MODE:
   - Structure around flight arrival logistics, airport transfers, hotel check-in, city sightseeing highlights, and return flight departure logistics.
   - Packages are categorized as: 'cheapest' (Budget Saver), 'moderate' (Balanced Choice), and 'luxury' (Signature Luxury VIP).

STANDARD DAY TIMINGS & DEFINITIONS (STRICT COMPLIANCE REQUIRED):
- MORNING (05:00 AM - 11:59 AM): Breakfast at 08:00 AM, morning cultural museums, iconic attractions, or road trip scenic morning stops at 09:30 AM - 11:30 AM.
- NOON / MIDDAY (12:00 PM - 12:59 PM): Lunch at 12:00 PM - 01:30 PM at top-rated local cafes, bistros, or famous en-route highway diners.
- AFTERNOON (01:00 PM - 04:59 PM): Afternoon promenades, historic districts, parks, viewpoints, en-route state/national parks, and cultural experiences (e.g. 02:00 PM - 04:30 PM on full days, or 03:15 PM - 05:15 PM on Day 1 after hotel check-in).
- EVENING (05:00 PM - 07:59 PM): Evening sunset attractions, panoramic towers, viewpoints, and dedicated Evening Shopping / Local Artisan Boutiques (05:30 PM - 07:45 PM). NEVER schedule evening activities during the afternoon (12:00 PM - 04:59 PM).
- NIGHT (08:00 PM - 11:59 PM): Signature regional dinner from 08:00 PM - 09:30 PM, followed by 'Return to Hotel & Rest for the Night' at 09:30 PM - 10:00 PM.
- MIDNIGHT / LATE NIGHT (12:00 AM - 04:59 AM): Resting at hotel (NO activities permitted).

REAL SPECIFIC NAMES (NO GENERIC PLACEHOLDERS):
- NEVER use generic placeholder names like 'Evening Landmark Attraction', 'Famous Landmark / Museum', 'Signature Dinner Place', 'Artisanal Breakfast', 'Gourmet Lunch', or 'Afternoon Activity & Promenade'.
- ALWAYS provide the REAL, ACTUAL, and FAMOUS name of the landmark, museum, restaurant, or experience.

STRICT TIMING & SEQUENCING RULES (UNBREAKABLE):
- CONTINUOUS SEQUENCING (ZERO UNALLOCATED GAPS): Every day's schedule MUST be completely continuous with back-to-back transitions and zero idle gaps. Fill late afternoon or pre-dinner gaps with dedicated Evening Shopping or Local Artisan Market browsing.
- SHOPPING PLACEMENT RULE: Shopping MUST ALWAYS be scheduled at the END OF THE DAY (in the evening before dinner or before returning to the hotel). NEVER schedule shopping during morning or afternoon sightseeing.
- ATTRACTION CUTOFF (08:00 PM MAXIMUM): Any attraction, museum, or sightseeing activity MUST end by 08:00 PM at the latest. NEVER extend any attraction past 08:00 PM.
- MANDATORY DINNER START AT 08:00 PM: Dinner MUST start at 08:00 PM at any cost (08:00 PM - 09:30 PM).
- MANDATORY HOTEL RETURN AS FINAL STEP (BEFORE 10:00 PM): The final step of EVERY day MUST be 'Return to Hotel & Rest for the Night' (09:30 PM - 10:00 PM).
- NO OVERNIGHT / EARLY MORNING SLOTS: Never generate activity or dinner time slots past 10:00 PM.
- EXACT JSON ONLY: Return strictly valid JSON adhering to the specified schema.
